reason: I already pay for Wox and a card terminal, and my waiters bring the terminal to the table in a minute. Another QR system means another thing for staff to explain, another set of payments to reconcile with the POS, and an extra transaction fee on top, so I'd let the free months go by and probably not keep paying.
objection: If it doesn't talk to my POS, my manager has to match two payment records every night and the staff have to juggle two systems - and the payment partner's fee comes on top of what I already pay my bank.
would_change_my_mind: A direct integration with Wox/SQR so the bill closes in my POS automatically, plus proof from a few Tbilisi restaurants that tourists actually leave reviews and come back through it.
